entities.summary: Kahlil Quinton Dukes is an American professional basketball player for Kocaeli BB Kağıtspor of the Turkish Basketball First League. He played college basketball for the University of Southern California (USC) and Niagara University and was named the 2018 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference Co-Player of the Year.
